disambiguation: Not a note-taking application; it is a design tool for creating covers and posters within Obsidian.
extras: Requires manual installation via GitHub Releases; AI services are optional and user-configured.
motivation: It is suitable for creators who continuously produce Xiaohongshu covers, article headers, video thumbnails, reading cards, and course posters, and Obsidian users who want to turn knowledge notes into shareable images.
problem: Users must leave Obsidian to use external design tools to convert notes and ideas into shareable covers or posters.
summary: Qiaomu Design allows users to create editable covers and posters directly within Obsidian using AI image generation, templates, and freehand drawing tools.
